After a successful decomposition, I'm handling the upper-triangle zeroing of local rows directly inside the decomposition routine so the full matrix can later be assembled cleanly for printing or validation.\n\nNow I'm writing a gather routine that uses a contiguous row MPI datatype and Allgatherv to collect each rank's local rows into a full matrix, computing per-rank row counts and displacements, then reordering the gathered buffer since rows are distributed cyclically across ranks. I'm also checking edge cases like n=0, making sure empty buffers and zero-count collectives behave safely, and noting that zero operations will produce a NaN GFLOPS value just like the original code.\n\nFor validation, I'm computing the reconstructed matrix entries from L by summing products of L's rows, comparing against the original matrix to get max absolute and relative error, then using Allreduce to combine these across ranks so rank 0 can print the results and decide whether to report validation failure, matching the original's error formatting and threshold logic.\n\nNow I'm drafting the CMakeLists.txt, setting C++20, enabling MPI, adding optimization and warning flags, and linking against MPI and the math library—keeping the project language defaults as in the original since FindMPI's C++ support works fine without explicit LANGUAGES.\n\nMoving to the full source file, I confirm the include path for results_output.hpp is correct, double-check that MPI_Init happens before argument parsing, verify stdout flushes properly at exit, and keep the unknown-option error handling and rank-0 printing consistent with the original logic including the diagonal sum computation and per-step broadcast size.\n\n","time":{"start":1792990771650,"end":1792990796619},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}

A column-oriented sweep performs exactly the same operations per element, so I can distribute rows cyclically across ranks. {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792990809990,"sessionID":"ses_e896d4485ffeNxi0wMdHXd6tuy","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01Cp6gCaukJ5dfrSoiNTLwp2","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/cholesky_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r2/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Distributed-memory Cholesky decomposition (MPI).\n//\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular.\n//\n// Data distribution: rows are distributed cyclically over the ranks (global row i\n// lives on rank i % P as local row i / P). Each rank stores only its rows, row-major.\n//\n// Algorithm: column-oriented (left-looking) sweep. At step j:\n//   1. The owner of row j computes the pivot L[j][j] and the prefix L[j][0..j].\n//   2. The prefix is broadcast to all ranks.\n//   3. Every rank updates column j of its local rows i > j.\n// Every element L[i][j] is computed with exactly the same sequence of floating-point\n// operations as the original row-oriented algorithm (sum over k = 0..j-1 in increasing\n// order), so the result is bit-identical for any number of ranks.\n\nnamespace {\n\n// Number of rows owned by `rank` when n rows are distributed cyclically over `size` ranks.\nsize_t localRowCount(size_t n, int rank, int size) {\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    return n > r ? (n - r - 1) / P + 1 : 0;\n}\n\n// Update column j of local rows [li0, nLoc) using the broadcast prefix rowj[0..j-1]\n// and pivot Ljj. Four rows are processed together to expose instruction-level\n// parallelism; each row's sum is still accumulated in increasing k order.\nvoid updateColumn(double* Aloc, size_t n, size_t li0, size_t nLoc, size_t j,\n                  const double* rowj, double Ljj) {\n    size_t li = li0;\n    for (; li + 4 <= nLoc; li += 4) {\n        double* r0 = Aloc + li * n;\n        double* r1 = r0 + n;\n        double* r2 = r1 + n;\n        double* r3 = r2 + n;\n        double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            const double b = rowj[k];\n            s0 += r0[k] * b;\n            s1 += r1[k] * b;\n            s2 += r2[k] * b;\n            s3 += r3[k] * b;\n        }\n        r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / Ljj;\n        r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / Ljj;\n        r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / Ljj;\n        r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / Ljj;\n    }\n    for (; li < nLoc; ++li) {\n        double* r = Aloc + li * n;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            sum += r[k] * rowj[k];\n        }\n        r[j] = (r[j] - sum) / Ljj;\n    }\n}\n\n// Decompose the distributed matrix in place. On success, Aloc holds the local rows of L\n// (zeros above the diagonal). Returns the same value on all ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const size_t n, int rank, int size) {\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    const size_t nLoc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n\n    // rowBuf[0]: failure flag; rowBuf[1 + k]: L[j][k] for k = 0..j\n    std::vector<double> rowBuf(n + 1);\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % P);\n        double* buf = rowBuf.data() + 1;\n        rowBuf[0] = 0.0;\n\n        if (owner == rank) {\n            const size_t lj = j / P;\n            double* rowj = Aloc.data() + lj * n;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += rowj[k] * rowj[k];\n            }\n            const double val = rowj[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                rowBuf[0] = 1.0;  // Matrix is not positive definite\n            } else {\n                const double Ljj = sqrt(val);\n                rowj[j] = Ljj;\n                std::copy(rowj, rowj + j, buf);\n                buf[j] = Ljj;\n            }\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(rowBuf.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 2), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (rowBuf[0] != 0.0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // First local row with global index i > j (global i = rank + li * P).\n        const size_t li0 = (static_cast<size_t>(rank) > j)\n                               ? 0\n                               : (j - static_cast<size_t>(rank)) / P + 1;\n        updateColumn(Aloc.data(), n, li0, nLoc, j, buf, buf[j]);\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part of local rows\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nLoc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(rank) + li * P;\n        double* r = Aloc.data() + li * n;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            r[j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (distributed: each rank fills its own rows).\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& Aloc, const size_t n, int rank, int size) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    // Every rank generates the same full B from the same seed.\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute local rows of A = B * B^T\n    const size_t nLoc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nLoc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(rank) + li * static_cast<size_t>(size);\n        double* row = Aloc.data() + li * n;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            row[j] = sum;\n        }\n        // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n        row[i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\n// Gather the row-distributed matrix into a full n x n row-major matrix on every rank.\nstd::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& Aloc, const size_t n, int rank, int size) {\n    MPI_Datatype rowType;\n    MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, &rowType);\n    MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(size), displs(size);\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(localRowCount(n, r, size));\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> ordered(n * n);  // rows grouped by owning rank\n    MPI_Allgatherv(Aloc.data(), counts[rank], rowType, ordered.data(), counts.data(),\n                   displs.data(), rowType, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n\n    std::vector<double> full(n * n);\n    for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        for (int li = 0; li < counts[r]; ++li) {\n            const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(r) + static_cast<size_t>(li) * size;\n            std::memcpy(&full[i * n], &ordered[(static_cast<size_t>(displs[r]) + li) * n],\n                        n * sizeof(double));\n        }\n    }\n    return full;\n}\n\n// Validate by computing L * L^T on the local rows and comparing with the original matrix.\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& AorigLoc,\n                      const size_t n, int rank, int size) {\n    const size_t nLoc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nLoc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(rank) + li * static_cast<size_t>(size);\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            const double orig = AorigLoc[li * n + j];\n            const double error = fabs(sum - orig);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(orig) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &maxError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &relError, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n    }\n\n    // Allocate local rows of the matrix\n    const size_t nLoc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    std::vector<double> A(nLoc * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    if (rank == 0) printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n, rank, size);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A;  // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (rank == 0) printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n, rank, size);\n\n    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - t0;\n    double elapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    const long durationMs = static_cast<long>(elapsed * 1000.0);\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", durationMs);\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n        double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        double gflops = ops / (durationMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Assemble the full L matrix when it is needed for output or validation\n    std::vector<double> L;\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        L = gatherMatrix(A, n, rank, size);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && rank == 0) {\n        print_results(L, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(L, A_orig, n, rank, size);\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n        return valid ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int ret = runBenchmark(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return ret;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/cholesky_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r2/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/cholesky_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r2/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","time":{"start":1792990809927,"end":1792990809983}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_176945b67001n3u4c0MkM4plrH","sessionID":"ses_e896d4485ffeNxi0wMdHXd6tuy","messageID":"msg_17693f5df001y0hyJb3jN4KKDY"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792990949537,"sessionID":"ses_e896d4485ffeNxi0wMdHXd6tuy","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_0185QC4eQLtytTCM8pZNHVBL","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/run/llm-eval/state/tmp/opencode/orig/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    for (int i = 1;
